verdict.rationale: Convertio is a file-conversion service, so conversion fidelity is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only shows format breadth (25,600+ conversions across 300+ formats), OCR via API, and video settings. Nothing documents preserving layout, fonts, images, or tables in document conversions, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power user, document conversion preserves layout, fonts, images, and tables rather than flattening them
